title.zh: 宣布每年10月17日为索索贡全省特别假日，以庆祝并纪念其建省周年的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring October 17 of Every Year as a Special Holiday in the Whole Province of Sorsogon in Celebration and Commemoration of the Anniversary of Its Establishment
title.orig: An Act Declaring October 17 of Every Year as a Special Holiday in the Whole Province of Sorsogon in Celebration and Commemoration of the Anniversary of Its Establishment

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7380_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and of laws, not inconsistent herewith, October 17, of every year is hereby declared a special holiday throughout the Province of Sorsogon in commemoration and celebration of the anniversary of its foundation as a local government unit.

All government officials in the province, national and local, elected and appointed, shall see to it to look forward every year thereafter to spearhead the commemoration of the foundation day of the province.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
